name: Võ Chí Công
contribution: A Vietnamese communist revolutionary, and the Chairman of the Council of State of Vietnam between 1987 and 1992.

checks.lead: Võ Chí Công (Vietnamese: [vɔ˦ˀ˥ t͡ɕi˧˦ kəwŋ͡m˧˧]; born Võ Toàn [vɔ˦ˀ˥ twaːn˨˩]; 7 August 1912 – 8 September 2011) was a Vietnamese communist revolutionary, and the Chairman of the Council of State of Vietnam (Alternatively: President of Vietnam) between 1987 and 1992. He was the Standing Deputy Chairman of the National Front for the Liberation of South Vietnam from 1962 to 1976.
